messages.content:
You design the support-topic map for a fictional clinical practice-management product used by outpatient clinics. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. List the topics customers most often contact support about, each a specific, distinct how-to question or problem (for example 'Move an appointment to another provider', not 'Scheduling'). Topics must not overlap. Cover every product area below with at least 4 topics.

Product areas (id: scope):
- scheduling: appointments, provider calendars, reminders, waitlists, recurring visits
- e-prescribing: sending prescriptions electronically, pharmacy directory, favorites and renewal requests, controlled-substance setup
- lab-orders-results: placing lab orders, lab interfaces, receiving and reviewing results
- billing: claims, patient statements, payment posting, insurance eligibility, and the practice's own subscription invoices
- patient-portal: patient accounts, secure messaging, online booking, forms, viewing results
- account-admin: staff accounts, passwords, roles and permissions, practice settings

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: product_spec.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"Topic": {"properties": {"area": {"description": "One of the product area ids", "title": "Area", "type": "string"}, "description": {"description": "One or two sentences: what customers ask, and why", "title": "Description", "type": "string"}, "id": {"description": "Short kebab-case id, unique across all topics", "title": "Id", "type": "string"}, "title": {"description": "What the customer wants to do, in the imperative", "title": "Title", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["id", "area", "title", "description"], "title": "Topic", "type": "object"}}, "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"summary": {"description": "Two or three sentences on what the product does", "title": "Summary", "type": "string"}, "topics": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Topic"}, "title": "Topics", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["summary", "topics"], "title": "product_spec", "type": "object"}
Write the product summary and exactly 40 topics.
